flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open Hati with no saved data (clear this site's browser storage and reload if any bills or people exist).
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy.
Click Add bill and enter the name Groceries.
Enter the amount 1,000.01 and choose all three people, Ana, Ben and Cy.
Choose the percentage split and enter 50 for Ana, 30 for Ben and 20 for Cy.
Save the bill and look at each person's share of the bill.
Assert Ana's share shows 500.01.
Assert Ben's share shows 300.00.
Assert Cy's share shows 200.00.
Get the shares shown for Ana, Ben and Cy, in that order, as one comma-separated line and save as {{percentage_split_shares}}.

wait: queued plan (2 steps): type "Name"; click "Add person"

wait: PRIMARY: confirm the saved Groceries bill percentage split is displayed
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'The shares shown for Ana, Ben and Cy, in that order, ar
